subject: Next steps: budget path, economic owner, and $/1M token target
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dunne <cdunne@bytewave.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today — token profile & quick ask on decision owner

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about ByteWave's roadmap for personalized customer summaries. Quick recap and two asks so we can put a rough commercial draft together: 

What we heard from you (please flag anything we missed):
- Primary workload: multi-turn summarization of support threads + webhook calls for semantic search (average seq len ~256 tokens).
- Active users: ~12k monthly actives, expected to scale to ~40k by Q4.
- Estimated generation volume (current): ~200M tokens/mo (peak bursts up to 350M).
- Quality bar: parity with current gpt-4 style outputs for summaries; 95th-percentile latency need ~350ms.

Quick asks so we can size pricing options: 
1) Who is the economic buyer/owner for model costs? (name + best email) — we want to confirm decision path before sharing an initial committed quote.
2) Target $/1M tokens or a budget range for this initiative? If you can give a target range (e.g., <$1k, $1k–$5k, $5k+ per 1M tokens) that helps us map to Dedicated vs. Hosted options.

I attached a short pricing sheet and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that maps milestones to procurement steps — just for context.

I can follow up with two pricing bands (hosted burst + 12-month committed) once we confirm the owner and the ballpark rate.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
[attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)]
[attachment: mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (pdf, 85KB)]

From: Claire Dunne <cdunne@bytewave.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Mukherjee <tara.mukherjee@bytewave.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — token profile & quick ask on decision owner

Thanks Aditya — solid recap. Couple quick clarifications: 

- The 200M token figure is current aggregate across experiments; production is closer to 120M but we expect a Q4 push to ~300M.
- Latency target is soft for now; we do want to prioritize cost without regressing quality.

Answers to your asks: 
- Economic owner is Tara Mukherjee (she's leading platform spend). I'm cc'ing her.
- For a target rate, we haven't set one yet internally. Our FP&A is sensitive to per-unit economics — I'd say they'd be happy to see options in <$2k/1M and a conservative $2k–$5k/1M bracket.

Tara — can you confirm if procurement should be looped in at this stage (procurement@bytewave.ai) and if there's a preferred cadence for commercial review?

Best,
Claire
Head of ML Platforms, ByteWave

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Mukherjee <tara.mukherjee@bytewave.ai>
Cc: Claire Dunne <cdunne@bytewave.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed pricing bands and next procurement steps

Hi Tara — pleasure to e-meet. Claire shared the context and suggested you are the economic owner for this initiative. I've attached the same MAP and a short pricing summary (two bands) for quick feedback. High-level options: 

Option A — Hosted (flexible, pay-as-you-go with tiered discounts):
- Band 1 (low commitment): $2,800 / 1M tokens (recommended for early phase + bursty traffic)
- Estimated monthly: 120M tokens -> ~$336k/mo at list; we would propose an initial pilot credit and usage-based pricing to validate.

Option B — Dedicated (committed 12-month capacity for steady unit economics):
- Band 2 (12-month commit): $1,250 / 1M tokens (for sustained 250M+ volumes)
- Includes reserved GPU pools, SLA, and priority routing.

Notes and asks from our side: 
- Can you confirm who signs on budget (procurement vs. platform engineering)? That impacts the PO path and typical lead times.
- Any internal target $/1M you prefer we prioritize when we prepare the formal quote? Claire suggested <$2k and $2k–$5k brackets are of interest.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (pricing bands + sample econ calc), mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (procurement milestones).

If it helps, Lauren (cc) can quickly run a tailored unit-econ table for the 3 user-growth scenarios and Marcus can align on comparable case studies for similar customers. Happy to set 30m with procurement this week.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
[attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)]
[attachment: mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (pdf, 85KB)]

From: Tara Mukherjee <tara.mukherjee@bytewave.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Claire Dunne <cdunne@bytewave.ai>
Cc: procurement@bytewave.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed pricing bands and next procurement steps

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear bands and the MAP. Confirming: 

- I'm the economic owner and will own the budget decision (Tara Mukherjee, Head of Platform Ops).
- Procurement should be looped in now; I've cc'd procurement@bytewave.ai.
- For internal planning, target preferred starting band is to see a Dedicated-style option near $1,200–$1,500 / 1M as the ideal, with a Hosted pilot in the $2,500–$3,000 / 1M range for short-term validation.
- Timeline: procurement review this week; would appreciate a tailored quote and a 30-minute PO/path call on Thu 05 Aug 2027.

Claire/Tara — you should see a HubSpot invite in a few minutes; Aditya — can you send the tailored econ scenarios for 120M/200M/300M monthly profiles ahead of the call? Lauren and Marcus are cc'd for that.

Regards,
Tara Mukherjee
Head of Platform Ops, ByteWave
